title: How a Sink P-Trap Prevents Sewer Gas Entry
description: The P-trap is a fundamental component located directly beneath sink basin outlets. Its engineered dip retains a small standing volume of water after every discharge cycle. This standing water creates a continuous atmospheric barrier within the pipe, preventing foul sewer odors, volatile organic compounds, and dangerous gases from migrating upward from the drainage network into the living area. During normal use, fresh incoming drain water flushes out the existing volume, continuously renewing the liquid seal while preserving safe, hygienic indoor air quality.

How a Sink P-Trap Prevents Sewer Gas Entry

The P-trap is a fundamental component located directly beneath sink basin outlets. Its engineered dip retains a small standing volume of water after every discharge cycle. This standing water creates a continuous atmospheric barrier within the pipe, preventing foul sewer odors, volatile organic compounds, and dangerous gases from migrating upward from the drainage network into the living area. During normal use, fresh incoming drain water flushes out the existing volume, continuously renewing the liquid seal while preserving safe, hygienic indoor air quality.
